hyperparameters.source: saved models' tuned_params (ml.train --tune on the training split); None = library/project defaults

holdout_payload_style.description: Train: benign-train + attacks of the other 4 styles. Test: benign-test + all attacks of the held-out style. Payload-style holdout, NOT a family holdout.

holdout_attack_family.description: For each fold, train on benign training sessions and all other attack families; test on benign test sessions plus the held-out attack family. This is a family holdout.

anomaly_benign_only.description: Fitted on benign sessions of the training tasks only; threshold = 0.95 quantile of their anomaly scores (target FPR about 5%). No attack data used for fitting or thresholds.

grouped_cv_tuned.description: Nested CV: for each outer fold, hyperparameters are searched on the outer training tasks only (inner GroupKFold(3) on task_id, pooled out-of-fold F1; ml/tuning.py), then the model is refitted with the winner and predicts the held-out tasks.

headline.protocol: nested task-grouped cross-validation (GroupKFold(n_splits=5) on task_id, 6 tasks; hyperparameters tuned inside each outer training fold)
headline.why: no task is in both train and test, so seed-level near-duplicates cannot be memorised; the held-out tasks never influence the chosen settings
